## Poster

We'll have the poster session on **December 4** from 9:45 to 11 on the 5th floor of Bellamy.

- You'll need to have your posters turned in to me by Tuesday, **November 25** for printing.
- Your poster must be 36" (W) by 24" (H).
- Requirements and tips for the posters are [here](https://gist.github.com/carlislerainey/cfd128077ba7bff3350022129bb097c2).

## Poster

Finish a first draft of the poster. 

- I recommend using Google Slides and starting with [this template](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1czi5EQdlLC_-kGiQhIDkCztHbROq22lFzL290mH3uAQ/copy).
- Review this [guide to the posterpalooza](https://gist.github.com/carlislerainey/cfd128077ba7bff3350022129bb097c2).
- [Watch this video]( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1RwJbhkCA58&t=4s). *If you want*, [watch this follow-up video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SYk29tnxASs). You do not need to follow the author's suggested model, but he does give you lots to think about!
- Remember that it needs to be 36" by 24". 
- I'm happy to take a quick look at drafts of figures or posters via email. (The more polished you make it, the more helpful I can be.)
